This '''unidentified [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3951 BBY]].

==Biography==
A bartender who worked at the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located at the [[Nar Shaddaa Docks]], he served nutrient chemicals to the the bar's many [[Alien/Legends|alien]] patrons. When [[Meetra Surik]] entered the establishment in an attempt to rescue [[Mira]] from [[Exchange]] boss [[Visquis]], he was among those who answered the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren's]] call to arms when the bar's [[cyanogen]] gas failed to subdue her. Though he attempted to cash in on the ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] unarmed, he was swiftly struck down, along with many of his customers.

==Behind the scenes==
If the Exile enters the Jekk'Jekk Tarr before the quest to meet Visquis activates, she can interact with the bartender, who explains the workings of the cantina to her.
